title: White Cliffe label's weak artists and unpaid studio bills
summary: Matassa let hopefuls use his studio and put out their records on White Cliffe, and NOLA left a $27,000 unpaid studio bill.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work
